newsitem.title: ITALY: Fiat Italy car registrations fall in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Fiat Italy car registrations fall in Sept.

text.p: Italian new car registrations for car maker Fiat fell 17.48 percent during September compared to year-ago levels, according to figures from the Italian Ministry of Transport.
September car registrations for all Fiat car marques fell to 48,900 from 59,258 in September 1995, the figures showed.
Total new car registrations in Italy for September fell 8.55 percent to 116,000.
The Fiat group figures include all Fiat marques in Italy including Fiat-Innocenti, Alfa Romeo and Lancia Autobianchi.

Fiat-Innocenti September new car registrations fell 18.76 percent to 37,200 from 45,788 in September 1995, Alfa Romeo was down 41.46 percent to 3,500 from 5,979, while Lancia Autobianchi showed a rise up 9.46 percent to 8,200 from 7,491.
